elements.text: ENTERPRISE ZERO-TRUST ARCHITECTURE GOVERNANCE & ACCESS CONTROL

Section 1.1 Policy Overview: All access requests to enterprise resources, documents, and microservices must be explicitly authenticated, cryptographically authorized, and inspected for anomalous topological behavior prior to session establishment.

Section 1.2 Cryptographic Session Lineage: All operations across document AI endpoints must record client identity, timestamp, and SHA-256 digests. Multi-factor hardware security tokens are mandatory for administrative elevation.
Section 1.3 Degraded Network Fallback: When zero-trust control planes encounter network partitions, endpoints must enter safe degraded mode with audit isolation rather than silently failing open.
Notice: Quarterly security audits must be submitted to the Compliance Bureau within 15 calendar days.
